steps.title: Three control-plane replicas elect a leader
steps.narration: Each replica starts as a follower with a randomized election timer. The first to time out asks for votes and wins a majority.

steps.title: Sign payments-api 1.4.2 and roll it out
steps.narration: The release is signed with an Ed25519 key. Connected regions pull it; the air-gapped region receives it as a signed offline package. Every region verifies the signature and SHA-256 digest itself before installing.

steps.title: eu-west loses its network path
steps.narration: The region keeps running 1.4.2. Nothing it cannot verify will be installed, and anything sent to it waits in the replicated log.

steps.title: The leader crashes mid-rollout
steps.narration: With one of three replicas gone, the remaining two still form a majority. One times out, wins the election, commits a no-op in its new term, and starts accepting writes.

steps.title: Roll out 1.4.3 with a dead replica and a dark region
steps.narration: us-east confirms right away through the new leader. eu-west cannot be reached, so its job stays pending in the log. adc-1 gets it on the next courier trip.

steps.title: A client retries the same request
steps.narration: The operator's CLI times out and resends deploy-1.4.3-1. The job id is the idempotency key, so the replicated state machine records it once and ignores the copy.

steps.title: us-east's worker dies after installing, before reporting back
steps.narration: This is the moment that causes double deploys. The agent wrote the result to its local ledger before acknowledging, so when it restarts and sees the job still pending it reports the recorded result instead of running it again.

steps.title: A package is altered on its way into adc-1
steps.narration: One byte of the artifact changes in transit. The signed manifest still says what the bytes must hash to, so adc-1 rejects the whole package and installs nothing. The next clean package goes through.

steps.title: eu-west comes back with a backlog
steps.narration: While it was dark, 1.4.4 was also queued for eu-west. On reconnect the agent compares desired and actual state, skips straight to the newest generation, marks 1.4.3 as superseded, and never installs an older version over a newer one.

steps.title: The crashed replica restarts and catches up
steps.narration: It rejoins as a follower, receives the entries it missed, and applies them. All three replicas end with byte-identical state.
